name: script-dispatch
description: From the Damocles title screen, press Space once, wait for world load, capture, then disassemble the live 68000 code from $05193E — the dispatch loop reached from $051956, the only instruction in RAM that names the resident script program counter at $00781E (movea.l $781E.w,a0) — through the dispatch table and every handler stub. Working-Authority Evidence for the Damocles Script dispatch loop (#81, #85). The disassembly runs last because Hatari stops consuming FIFO commands after a listing. The listing is untracked Restricted Material; only decoded facts enter research notes.
